选择截图后的行为，设置顺手的快捷键。: Choose what happens after capture and set your shortcuts.
选择服务，在这里配置和测试连接。: Choose a service, configure it and test the connection.
选择文字识别方式，默认在本机完成。: Choose an OCR service. Recognition runs locally by default.
按上述自动翻译选项打开统一工作区。: Open the workspace using your automatic translation preference.
打开同一工作区，此次仅截图，按需提取或翻译。: Open the workspace without automatic OCR or translation.
点击“修改”后按键，或选择“手动填写”: Click Change and press the keys, or choose Type shortcut.
点击或点“修改”后直接按键；也可选择“手动填写”: Click to record keys, or choose Type shortcut.
请按新的快捷键，例如 F3 或 Ctrl+Q；Esc 撤销: Press a shortcut, such as F3 or Ctrl+Q. Esc cancels.
输入完整快捷键后自动保存，例如 F3、Ctrl+Q: Type a shortcut, such as F3 or Ctrl+Q. It saves automatically.
请直接按新的快捷键，松键后自动保存: Press the shortcut. Release the keys to save.
手动输入快捷键，停止输入后自动保存: Type a shortcut. It saves when you finish typing.
正在录入：请直接按键，例如 F3 或 Ctrl+Q: Recording: press keys, such as F3 or Ctrl+Q.
未录入新按键，保留原设置: No new shortcut recorded. Keeping the previous one.
暂不支持 Windows 键组合，请使用 Ctrl / Alt / Shift: Windows-key shortcuts are not supported. Use Ctrl / Alt / Shift.
请按新的快捷键；Esc 恢复原设置: Press a shortcut. Esc restores the previous one.
不支持这个按键，请选择功能键或 Ctrl / Alt / Shift 组合: Unsupported key. Choose a function key or Ctrl / Alt / Shift combination.
交换语言；自动检测时请先指定原文语言: Swap languages. Select a source language first when using auto-detect.
选择原文和译文语言。切换引擎时沿用；工作区与贴图也可修改。MyMemory 需指: Choose source and target languages. These carry across services and can also be changed in the workspace or a pin. MyMemory requires an explicit source language.
以原始截图像素为单位；可拖动滑块或直接输入: In original capture pixels. Drag the slider or type a value.
数值越大，马赛克块越大；橡皮擦可恢复原图: Higher values create larger mosaic blocks. Erase to restore the original.
点击数字后直接输入；Ctrl+A 全选替换: Click to type. Ctrl+A selects the entire value.
点击“提取文字”，识别结果会显示在这里: Click Extract text to show recognized text here.
图片已复制；可粘贴到聊天、文档或画图软件: Image copied. Paste it into a chat, document or image editor.
保存失败，请检查所选目录是否可写: Could not save. Check that the selected folder is writable.
从截图提取文字，独立于翻译服务。: Extract text from captures, independently of translation.
填写已加载的视觉模型名称，须支持图片输入: Enter a loaded model that supports image input
使用当前 Windows 用户加密保存识别密钥: Encrypt OCR key for this Windows user
测试只发送公开示例图片。识别时只发送框选区域；视觉模型可能漏字或改写，重要内容请: Testing sends a public sample. OCR sends only the selected region. Vision models may omit or rephrase text; check important content against the original.
离线运行，截图留在本机。附带模型主要识别中文和英文；其他语种建议选择对应的视觉模: Runs offline. Captures stay local. The bundled OCR primarily recognizes Chinese and English; choose a suitable vision model for other languages.
留空保留已保存密钥: Leave blank to keep the saved key
填写所选服务的 API Key: Enter the selected service's API key
先在本机加载支持图片的视觉模型，再填写模型名称。: Load a local model that accepts images, then enter its name.
框选图片将发送给此服务。识别配置和翻译配置分别保存。: Selected images are sent to this service. OCR and translation settings are stored separately.
请先填写此识别服务的 API Key: Enter this OCR service's API key first
无法读取此识别服务的密钥，请重新填写。: Could not read the OCR key. Enter it again.
移动工具：拖动图片 · 右下角缩放 · 滚轮缩放 · Ctrl+滚轮透明度 ·: Move: drag image · corner/wheel to zoom · Ctrl+wheel for opacity · middle/double-click to reset · right-click for actions
缩放 / 透明度；滚轮缩放，Ctrl+滚轮调整透明度: Zoom / opacity. Wheel to zoom, Ctrl+wheel for opacity.
关闭当前贴图并返回文字工作区提取 / 编辑文字；仅查看原图请点“查看原文”: Close this pin and return to the workspace to extract or edit text. Use Original to compare here.
在当前贴图完成识别和翻译，不返回工作区: Recognize and translate inside this pin
此贴图使用的翻译服务；选择后点击翻译: Translation service for this pin. Select one, then click Translate.
语言已修改，点击翻译生成新的译文: Languages changed. Click Translate for a new translation.
关闭当前贴图并返回截图工作区；贴图编辑可先复制或保存: Close this pin and return to the workspace. Copy or save edits first.
在贴图当前位置切换原图 / 译文，保留缩放与标注 · Tab: Compare original and translation here, keeping zoom and annotations · Tab
当前就是原始截图；翻译后贴图即可切换原文 / 译文: Showing the original. Translate to enable comparison.
保存失败，请选择可写目录后重试: Could not save. Choose a writable folder and try again.
px；显示像素比例 / 透明度\nCtrl+0 原始像素，Ctrl+9 适应屏:
px; pixel scale / opacity
Ctrl+0 actual pixels, Ctrl+9 fit screen; Alt+drag to pan when zoomed
只擦除标注，保留截图原始内容: Erase annotations, keeping the original image
确定修改学术翻译提示词？修改会影响之后的学术翻译。: Edit the academic prompt? Changes affect future academic translations.
确定保存新的学术翻译提示词？保存后对下一次学术翻译生效。: Save this academic prompt? It will apply to the next academic translation.
大模型使用下面的提示词。默认锁定；修改与保存分别确认。Google、微软和 My: LLMs use this prompt. It is locked by default, with separate confirmations for editing and saving. Traditional translation services do not use it.
可使用 {source_language} 和 {target_language: Use {source_language} and {target_language} for the selected languages. The language selectors determine the translation direction.
点击图标配置服务。保存后才会启用；关闭设置将保留原来的配置。: Select a service to configure it. Save to apply; closing keeps the previous configuration.
识别后的原文；可修改后重新翻译: Recognized text. Edit it and translate again.
选择其他引擎后，会用当前原文重新翻译，无需再截图: Switch service to translate this text again without recapturing.
复制原文并打开翻译网页: Copy source and open translation website
原文已复制并打开网页；若未自动填入，可在网页中粘贴。: Source copied and website opened. Paste the text if it was not filled automatically.
原文已修改，译文尚未更新: Source edited. Translate again to update.
保留 OCR 最初的换行，方便核对漏字。此处只读，不影响原文编辑或重新翻译。: Original OCR line breaks for checking omissions. This read-only view does not affect edits or translations.
译文可能不完整，请缩小选区重试: Translation may be incomplete. Try a smaller region.
拖拽选择文字区域 · Esc / 右键取消: Drag to select text · Esc / right-click to cancel
复制模型页代码中的 model，或点击下方获取模型: Enter a model ID or use Fetch models below
例如 eastasia；全局 Translator 资源可留空: e.g. eastasia; leave blank for a global resource
百度 APP ID / 有道应用 ID；不是密钥: Baidu / Youdao App ID (not the secret)
使用当前 Windows 用户加密保存: Encrypt key for this Windows user
按模型页面示例填写请求体参数。留 {} 使用模型默认值；不要在这里填写密钥。: Request parameters from the model's documentation. Leave {} for defaults. Do not put keys here.
结果窗口默认置顶: Keep reading windows on top by default
弹窗显示原文和译文: Reading window with source and translation
各引擎分别保留配置，翻译后也能切换。: Each service keeps its own configuration. Switch after translating too.
翻译服务接收识别后的文本。若启用云端 OCR，框选图片会另行发送给 OCR 服务: Translation receives recognized text. Cloud OCR sends the selected image to the OCR service separately. Connection tests use a public sample sentence.
点击预览。保存后应用到设置、弹窗和工具栏；直接关闭会保留原主题。: Click to preview. Save to apply across settings, reading views and toolbars. Close to keep your previous theme.
工作区与弹窗内都可继续切换，无需重新截图。: Switch between workspace and reading view without recapturing.
设置窗口正常切换，不会强制置顶。弹窗的“置顶”可随时开关；拖动窗口边缘调整大小。: Settings behave like a normal window. Toggle Always on top in reading views and drag window edges to resize.
贴图可以拖动、滚轮缩放，并返回工作区继续操作。: Drag pins, zoom with the wheel or return to the workspace.
首次使用会先进入设置。配置、日志与缓存保存在程序目录的 data 文件夹。: First launch opens settings. Configuration, logs and caches stay in the data folder next to the application.
保存全部待保存的偏好 · Ctrl+S；快捷键与学术提示词分别保存: Save pending preferences · Ctrl+S. Shortcuts and the academic prompt save separately.
留空保留当前密钥: Leave blank to keep current key
填写密钥，不会写入普通配置: Enter key (not stored in plain config)
服务地址已变更，请重新填写密钥: Service URL changed. Enter the key again.
选择后使用模型卡片初始输出值，并重置高级参数。\n小样本实测仅供参考，效果和等待:
Uses the model-card output default and resets advanced parameters.
Presets are based on small sample tests; quality and latency may vary.
请选支持文本对话的模型。图像、嵌入、语音模型不能用于此翻译接口；也可关闭后直接填: Choose a chat-capable model. Image-only, embedding and audio models do not work with this translation endpoint. You can also enter a model ID directly.
请先填写有效数字再切换服务：: Enter valid numeric settings before switching:
尚无已核对的模型默认值；0 表示不传输出限制，由服务决定。: No verified model default. 0 leaves the output limit to the service.
点击数字可输入。模型卡片与示例不是上下文容量。: Click to type. This is an output limit, not context capacity.
切换引擎并用当前原文重新翻译: Switch service and translate the current source again
贴图 · 保留当前画面，可返回工作区: Pin this view; return to the workspace later
选区较小，打开弹窗查看完整译文: Small region. Open reading view for the full translation.
按住鼠标涂抹遮挡导出的图片；OCR 和翻译仍使用原始截图: Paint to obscure exported images. OCR and translation still use the original capture.
擦除标注和马赛克，恢复原始截图内容: Erase annotations and mosaic to restore the original image
欢迎使用。默认本地 OCR + MyMemory 免费翻译，F2 截图自动翻译。: Welcome. Defaults are local OCR and free MyMemory translation, with F2 to capture and translate. Keep these defaults or configure a service, then save at the top right.
框选完成后识别文字，并显示译文。: Recognize and translate text after selecting a region.
快捷键录入后自动保存。其他偏好在右上角保存。: Shortcuts save automatically. Save other preferences at the top right.
当前：截图 → 编辑图片；需要时再点翻译: Capture → Edit image → Translate when needed
个模型 ID；调用权限与参数以模型页面和测试连接结果为准。: model IDs. Check model documentation and test access for your account.
选择配色，预览你的工作空间。: Choose colors and preview your workspace.
查看和调整学术翻译使用的提示词。: Review and edit the academic translation prompt.
调整阅读、结果显示与启动习惯。: Customize language, reading, display and startup preferences.
本地 · 连接已启动的 Ollama，识别文本留在本机。: Connect to a running local Ollama server. Recognized text stays on this computer.
在 LM Studio 下载并加载模型，然后在 Developer 中启动本地服: Load a model in LM Studio and start its local server in Developer (port 1234 by default). Enter the loaded model ID. No cloud key required.
先运行 llama-server -m 模型.gguf --port 8080，: Run llama-server -m model.gguf --port 8080 and enter the ID returned by /v1/models. SnapTrans does not download or launch models.
先运行 vllm serve 模型 --port 8000，再填写服务返回的模型: Run vllm serve MODEL --port 8000, then enter its model ID. Usually deployed on Linux / WSL. Use HTTPS for remote servers.
支持兼容聊天接口的服务，填写地址与模型名称。: Connect to a compatible chat API. Enter its URL and model name.
使用自己的 NVIDIA API Key。选择支持文本对话的模型；目录可见不代表: Use your NVIDIA API key and a chat-capable model. Catalog visibility does not guarantee account access. Adjust output limits and advanced parameters for reasoning models.
Google Cloud Translation 官方接口，需自行配置密钥与计费: Official Google Cloud Translation API. Configure your own key and billing.
Microsoft Translator 官方接口，使用自己的资源密钥。: Official Microsoft Translator API. Use your resource key.
选择与你的 API 密钥一致的 Free / Pro 套餐；切换套餐后需填写对应: Choose the Free / Pro plan matching your key. Re-enter the appropriate key after switching plans.
开通百度通用文本翻译，填写 APP ID，并在 API Key 中填写应用密钥。: Enable Baidu text translation. Enter the App ID and app secret in API Key.
开通有道文本翻译，填写应用 ID，并在 API Key 中填写应用密钥。: Enable Youdao text translation. Enter the App ID and app secret in API Key.
开源免费自部署；需先运行 LibreTranslate 并安装英中模型，再填写地: Free self-hosted software. Run LibreTranslate and install the required language models first. The hosted service requires a paid key.
DeepSeek 官方 API，预设非思考翻译；模型可自行修改。: Official DeepSeek API. Non-reasoning translation preset; model is editable.
阿里云百炼，默认北京地域地址。可改为控制台业务空间专属地址；密钥须与地域一致。: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, Beijing endpoint by default. You can use a workspace endpoint; key and region must match.
默认 GLM-4.7-Flash 免费模型，需注册并获取密钥；其他模型可能收费，: Defaults to GLM-4.7-Flash. Registration and an API key are required. Check your account for pricing and limits of other models.
月之暗面官方 API，默认 Kimi K2.5 非思考模式；修改模型时请核对高级: Official Moonshot API, Kimi K2.5 non-reasoning preset. Check advanced parameters when changing models.
硅基流动模型平台。按控制台填写模型 ID；是否免费及限额以所选模型和账号为准。: SiliconFlow model platform. Enter a model ID from the console. Pricing and quotas depend on your account and model.
OpenAI 官方 API。与 ChatGPT 网页订阅独立；填写平台 API: Official OpenAI API, separate from ChatGPT subscriptions. Enter an API key and a chat-compatible model.
Google AI Studio 的 Gemini API，与 Google C: Google AI Studio Gemini API, separate from Cloud Translation. The 2.5 Flash preset disables thinking; remove reasoning_effort: none for 3-series models.
Anthropic 官方 Messages 接口。填写 Claude Conso: Official Anthropic Messages API. Enter a Claude Console key. Output limit 0 uses the app default of 4096.
xAI 官方 Grok API。填写 API Key 与账号可调用的模型名称。: Official xAI Grok API. Enter your key and an accessible model name.
火山方舟。将控制台的模型 ID 或 ep- 开头的推理接入点 ID 填入模型名称: Volcengine Ark. Enter a model ID or ep- endpoint ID from the console, plus your Ark API key.
腾讯混元官方接口。使用混元 API Key，不是腾讯云 SecretId / S: Official Tencent Hunyuan API. Use a Hunyuan API key, not Tencent Cloud SecretId / SecretKey.
百度千帆 v2 API，与百度翻译独立。填写千帆 API Key 和已开通的模型: Baidu Qianfan v2 API, separate from Baidu Translate. Enter your Qianfan key and an enabled model ID.
MiniMax 国内官方 API，默认 M3 非思考翻译。更换模型时核对思考参数: MiniMax official API, M3 non-reasoning preset. Check thinking parameters and output limits when changing models.
测试已超时，服务可能仍在排队或推理。可调整等待时间或换模型。: Test timed out. The service may still be queuing or processing. Increase the timeout or choose another model.
